entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi, Charlie. I... I need to make a return. It's for some cycling shoes I bought. I'm just so disappointed.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can certainly look into that for you. What specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
They just... they hurt so much. I've tried everything, adjusting the cleats, different socks, but they're giving me terrible blisters on my heels. I can't even ride in them anymore.
Oh, that sounds very uncomfortable. I can see why you'd want to return them. To check the eligibility, can you tell me when you received the order?

It was a little while ago... maybe a month and a half? I feel awful calling so late, I really tried to make them work. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years, and I just... I really needed this money back. I was hoping for a refund.
I understand completely. Let me just pull up our return policy for you. One moment... Okay, I've got it here. For standard items like our cycling shoes, we have a 90-day return window.
Oh, really? So it's not too late?

Not at all. You are well within the timeframe. I can go ahead and process that return for you right now. I'm so sorry again that they caused you blisters. I'm sending a prepaid return label to the email on your account now.
Wow, that's such a relief. Thank you so much, Charlie. I was so worried.

You're very welcome. Once we receive the shoes back at our warehouse, we'll issue a full refund to your original payment method. You should see it in 3-5 business days after that. Is there anything else I can help with?
No, that's everything. You've been a huge help. Thank you.
My pleasure. Have a wonderful day.
